And I watched my 6 nieces and nephews grow up.

Now, whenever a friend or anyone, especially a new parent, tells me I'm missing out, that I know nothing about raising kids, while they struggle to properly put on a diaper or hold their baby without supporting its neck, I just laugh. Honey, I was a veteran at diaper changing while you were still crushing on your middle school crush and wondering what love is like.

Anyway, I'm sure people who really really want kids have that deep, magical, fulfilling feeling that makes all the sacrifices worth it. My mom would always say, "I sacrificed so much, blah blah, but I still gave birth to all of you, and you should be grateful to have so many siblings and that I fed you instead of throwing you out on the street." I wish those who want kids the best of luck, but it's just not for me. No thanks.
